definitions.gloss: a child's mind; a child's feelings; childlike heart
definitions.explanation: The way a child feels and understands things, either as one was as a child ({子供心|こどもごころ}に) or as a playful, innocent spirit an adult keeps.

examples.japanese: {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くすぐる→くすぐる：07620_kusuguru⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧
examples.english: a toy that appeals to the child in you

examples.japanese: {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Even as a child, I felt lonely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{子供心|こどもごころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing my parents fight, I understood, child though I was, that things were hard at home.

notes:
USAGE:
{子供心|こどもごころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (or {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧) means "as a child, even a child could tell": it introduces something one felt or understood when young. {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ and {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くすぐる→くすぐる：07620_kusuguru⟧ speak of the childlike spirit in an adult.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as a child (I felt/understood)
- {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to keep a childlike heart
- {子供心|こどもごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くすぐる→くすぐる：07620_kusuguru⟧: to appeal to the child in one
